INSERT INTO LOG_FILES ( FILE_NO, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, USER_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, FILE_PATH ) VALUES ( #{fileNo}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{userNo}, #{sourceType}, #{filePath} )

SELECT SEQ_INSPECTIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO INSPECTIONS ( INS_NO, FILE_NO, INS_STATUS, START_DATE, TOTAL_LINES, ERROR_COUNT ) VALUES ( #{insNo}, #{fileNo}, 'PROCESSING', SYSDATE, 0, 0 )

SELECT SEQ_DETECTION_RESULTS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO DETECTION_RESULTS ( RESULT_NO, INS_NO, DET_NO, LINE_NO, LOG_CONTENT, DETECTED_VALUE ) VALUES ( #{resultNo}, #{insNo}, #{detNo}, #{lineNo}, #{logContent}, #{detectedValue} )
mapper.update: UPDATE INSPECTIONS SET INS_STATUS = 'FAILED', END_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE INS_NO = #{insNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT I.INS_NO, I.FILE_NO, I.INS_STATUS, I.TOTAL_LINES, I.ERROR_COUNT, F.FILE_NAME, F.SOURCE_TYPE, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT R.LINE_NO) FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R WHERE R.INS_NO = I.INS_NO ) AS "abnormalLogCount"
FROM INSPECTIONS I
JOIN LOG_FILES F ON I.FILE_NO = F.FILE_NO
WHERE I.INS_NO = #{insNo} AND F.USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT R.RESULT_NO, R.INS_NO, R.LINE_NO, D.DET_RULE_TYPE AS RULE_TYPE, D.DET_DESCRIPTION AS RULE_DESCRIPTION, R.DETECTED_VALUE, R.LOG_CONTENT
FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R
JOIN DETECTION_RULES D ON R.DET_NO = D.DET_NO
WHERE R.INS_NO = #{insNo}
ORDER BY R.LINE_NO, R.RESULT_NO

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT D.DET_RULE_TYPE AS "ruleType", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R
JOIN DETECTION_RULES D ON R.DET_NO = D.DET_NO
WHERE R.INS_NO = #{insNo}
GROUP BY D.DET_RULE_TYPE
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT I.INS_NO, I.FILE_NO, I.INS_STATUS, I.TOTAL_LINES, I.ERROR_COUNT, I.START_DATE, F.FILE_NAME, F.SOURCE_TYPE, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT R.LINE_NO) FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R WHERE R.INS_NO = I.INS_NO ) AS "abnormalLogCount" FROM INSPECTIONS I JOIN LOG_FILES F ON I.FILE_NO = F.FILE_NO WHERE F.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY I.INS_NO DESC
SELECT FILE_NO, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, USER_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, FILE_PATH FROM LOG_FILES WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY FILE_NO DESC
